Let \(\alpha_*=(52-16\sqrt3)/121\). Then
\[
\boxed{c(\alpha)=\begin{cases}
2,&0<\alpha\le \frac16,\\[2mm]
1+\frac{2\alpha}{3}+\frac43\sqrt{\alpha(3-2\alpha)},&\frac16<\alpha<\alpha_*,\\[2mm]
(1+\sqrt\alpha)^2,&\alpha_*\le\alpha\le1.
\end{cases}}
\]
The adjacent formulas agree at both transition points.
